from experiments import *
import collections

def inverse_constraints(c,first,second):
    name=c['id'];y,p=c['y'],c['p']
    a,b,g=[first[name+'_S'+str(k)] for k in range(1,4)]
    fs=[c['known_f1'] if h==1 and name!='B5' else second[name+f'_F{h}'] for h in range(1,p+2)]
    t=(fs[p]-fs[0])/float(p)
    l=sum(fs[h-1]-float(h)*t for h in range(1,p+1))/float(p)
    seasons=[0.]*p
    for h in range(1,p+1):seasons[(len(y)-1+h)%p]=fs[h-1]-l-float(h)*t
    terminal=dict(level=l,trend=t,seasons=list(seasons))
    errors=[0.]*len(y)
    for j in range(len(y)-1,0,-1):
        q=j%p;e=(y[j]-l-seasons[q])/(1.-a-g);errors[j]=e
        t-=b*e;seasons[q]-=g*e;l-=t+a*e
    center=sum(seasons)/float(p);l+=center;seasons=[s-center for s in seasons]
    return dict(id=name,reported_gains=[a,b,g],terminal=terminal,
      inferred_initial=dict(level=l,trend=t,seasons=seasons),inferred_errors=errors,
      warning='Approximate inverse constraints only. Assumes gains equal reported gains, direct innovations, standard additive forecast, no reset. Binary64 forecast publication makes inversion inexact; do not treat inferred decimals as certified initializer constants.')

def main():
    batches=['ties','short','seasonal-stage1','seasonal-stage2','tie-followup','covariance-followup','seasonal-hybrid','centering-followup']
    records=[]
    for name in batches:
        pred=OUT/(name+'-predictions.json');ans=json.loads((OUT/(name+'-answers.json')).read_text())
        assert hashlib.sha256(pred.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ans['predictions_sha256']
        committed=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ans['prediction_commit']+':'+str(pred.relative_to(ROOT))])
        assert committed==pred.read_bytes(),name
        assert len(json.loads(pred.read_text())['rows'])==len(ans['rows'])
        assert all(r['answer']['type']=='number' and len(r['answer']['bits'])==16 for r in ans['rows'])
        records.append(dict(batch=name,readings=len(ans['rows']),prediction_commit=ans['prediction_commit'],prediction_sha256=ans['predictions_sha256']))
    first=decoded('seasonal-stage1');second=decoded('seasonal-stage2')
    cov=json.loads((OUT/'covariance-followup-answers.json').read_text())
    common={}
    for row in cov['rows']:
        name=row['id'].split('_')[0]
        possible={k.split('_',1)[1] for k,match in row['matches'].items() if match and k.startswith('innovation_')}
        common[name]=common.get(name,possible)&possible
        assert not any(match for key,match in row['matches'].items() if key.startswith('traditional_'))
    assert all(common.values())
    cases=seasonal_cases()+[dict(id='B5',y=[float(256*j+(48 if j==8 else 0)) for j in range(12)],p=4)]
    shortp=json.loads((OUT/'short-predictions.json').read_text());shorta=json.loads((OUT/'short-answers.json').read_text())
    amap={r['id']:r for r in shorta['rows']}
    mismatches=[dict(id=r['id'],prediction=r['predictions']['landed_program'],answer=amap[r['id']]['answer']) for r in shortp['rows'] if not amap[r['id']]['matches']['landed_program']]
    byid=decoded('short')
    for name in [f'H{h}' for h in range(87,101)]+[f'fresh_n{n}_{k}' for n in range(4,8) for k in range(5)]:
        assert bits(byid[name+'_Cendpoint'])==bits(byid[name+'_S7'])
    save('results-summary.json',dict(total_readings=sum(r['readings'] for r in records),
      batches=records,short_mismatches=mismatches,
      seasonal_gains={c['id']:[val(first[c['id']+'_S'+str(k)]) for k in range(1,4)] for c in cases},
      covariance_common_variance_bits={k:sorted(v) for k,v in common.items()},
      inverse_constraints=[inverse_constraints(c,first,second) for c in cases],
      python_source=Path(__file__).read_text()))
    save('runner.json',dict(
      python3='Standard library only; reconstruct model.json python_source as work/ets_sim.py, runner source as work/experiments.py and followup sources from their prediction JSONs.',
      source=Path(ROOT/'work/experiments.py').read_text(),
      checks='Prediction SHA256 equals recorded answer SHA256, and git show at recorded pre-query commit equals each prediction file byte for byte. Every reading numeric. Short endpoint equals fresh STAT7 at n<=10. Each covariance history has at least one common V across all six outputs.',
      predicted_then_asked=True))
    print('Validated',sum(r['readings'] for r in records),'readings in',len(records),'precommitted batches')

if __name__=='__main__':main()
